content:
## The Home Depot, Inc. (HD) `[Retail]`
- Home Depot rose 4.83% during Thursday, October 15, 2026, alongside Sherwin-Williams (SHW), Walmart (WMT), and McDonald’s (MCD), as investors rotated from technology and AI stocks into consumer-focused equities; Nvidia (NVDA) and Amazon (AMZN) declined. The article attributed the rotation to concerns about AI financing and competition. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[1]
- The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 550 points, or 1.1%, with Home Depot among the advancing components; SHW, WMT, and MCD also rose while NVDA and AMZN fell. (Investopedia, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[3]
- Treasury yields fell more than 10 basis points on October 15, 2026, while Lennar (LEN) gained more than 5% and D.R. Horton (DHI), PulteGroup (PHM), Toll Brothers (TOL), and KB Home (KBH) also advanced; the move was linked to the potential for lower mortgage rates. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[2]
- Melius Research had upgraded Home Depot to Strong Buy on October 9, 2026, after initiating coverage at Buy with a $397 price target on October 6, 2026. (Ad-Hoc-News, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[7]
- Home Depot’s second-quarter fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS was $4.92 versus a $4.73 consensus estimate, and revenue was $47.86 billion versus a $47.24 billion consensus estimate; the company’s fiscal 2026 guidance remained 0%–2% comparable-sales growth and 2.5%–4.5% total-sales growth. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[8][9]
- A market article cited a $357.14 price target and Buy rating for Home Depot, while reporting a $291.14 intraday price and identifying a possible housing-turnover recovery as the principal catalyst. (24/7 Wall St., Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[6]
- Home Depot’s second-quarter comparable average ticket increased 2.8% year over year, comparable transactions declined 1.0%, total comparable sales rose 1.7%, and U.S. comparable sales rose 1.3%; transactions above $1,000 increased 2.4%. (Zacks/Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated)[9]
- No verified company-specific FDA, product-safety, privacy, lawsuit, verdict, government-action, offering, acquisition, or new filing catalyst was identified in the available results for the specified window.
- No verified after-hours or pre-market Home Depot move or catalyst through 02:03 ET on Friday, October 16, 2026 was identified in the available results.
